title: citrus × aurantium subsp. natsudaidai
intro: Citrus × aurantium subsp. natsudaidai, commonly known as Japanese bitter orange, is a hybrid citrus species that has been used in traditional medicine for its unique properties. The health benefits of Japanese bitter orange include its ability to aid in weight loss, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Citrus × aurantium subsp. natsudaidai include its use as a stimulant, diuretic, and carminative, which can help increase energy, relieve bloating, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Japanese bitter orange include flavonoids, limonoids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and can help to stimulate circulation, reduce inflammation, and promote overall well-being.
